execution_policy: Catalog display is read-only. Every installation, training, scheduler, remote, model-loading, and MD step requires separate authorization and a captured execution record.

preconditions: Isolated Python >=3.10 environment
Package index and network use explicitly authorized
PyTorch CPU backend selected and compatible PyTorch resolution is recorded

outputs: installed PyTorch distribution metadata and resolved dependency lock

recipes.restart: Recreate the isolated environment from the same lock; do not mutate a partially resolved environment without recording the delta.
failure_modes: Package resolver selects a different DeePMD-kit version
PyTorch is not the intended CPU build
scientific_checks: Installation proves availability only; it proves no model or result.

preconditions: dp executable resolved inside the intended environment
recipes.restart: Not applicable.
failure_modes: Executable and Python distribution resolve from different environments
scientific_checks: Record executable path and environment hash outside this catalog.

preconditions: Exact dp 3.1.3 executable and explicit backend are proven

outputs: provider-emitted JSON Schema for training input

recipes.restart: Regenerate after any provider/backend change.
failure_modes: Output not hashed or bound to environment
scientific_checks: Validate the rendered config against this exact provider/backend evidence; do not infer defaults.

preconditions: Audited DeePMD dataset at data/train
Ordered type map O,H is confirmed
Cutoff 6.0 Å is a predeclared candidate, not an accepted default
recipes.restart: Rerun whenever data, type order, periodicity, or cutoff changes.
scientific_checks: Choose descriptor sel from all relevant training environments with headroom and document the rule.

preconditions: input.json is audited against exact 3.1.3 PyTorch schema evidence
Dataset/type map/units/splits are audited
Seeds and every scientific hyperparameter are explicit
Compute and filesystem side effects are authorized
recipes.restart: Use the dedicated restart recipe with the unchanged config and checkpoint lineage.
failure_modes: Checkpoint cadence exceeds useful recovery window
Config or dataset changes during run
scientific_checks: Track train and validation energy/force/virial metrics separately
Do not select on test/OOD
A completed run is not an accepted potential

preconditions: Checkpoint prefix model.ckpt hash and parent run are recorded
input.json and environment are lineage-identical
No scientific setting changed
recipes.restart: If dataset, type map, backend, model shape, or loss changes, create a new training plan rather than call it a restart.
scientific_checks: Verify step continuity and compare first post-restart metrics with the parent trace.

preconditions: Accepted checkpoint prefix and backend are proven
Output path is new
recipes.restart: Freeze again to a new artifact after any accepted checkpoint changes.
scientific_checks: Hash the output and test the frozen artifact independently before deployment.

preconditions: frozen_model.pth passed the uncompressed validation gate
Compression tolerances are predeclared
recipes.restart: Compression creates a new artifact and never replaces the source model.
scientific_checks: Repeat held-out errors and force/energy consistency comparisons against the uncompressed model.

preconditions: Held-out system has never selected hyperparameters
Model and data type maps/units match
Detail prefix is new

outputs: energy/force/virial detail files when labels exist

recipes.restart: Rerun from scratch for each immutable model/data pair.
scientific_checks: Report MAE/RMSE and tail errors by system and chemistry; a single aggregate error is insufficient.

preconditions: Four independently seeded model artifacts are frozen and type-compatible
Target data are immutable
recipes.restart: Rerun for the exact ensemble/data hashes; never append across ensembles.
failure_modes: Deviation thresholds tuned on the same candidates
scientific_checks: Calibrate deviation thresholds against actual errors; ensemble disagreement is not a guaranteed uncertainty bound.

preconditions: Loading the model artifact is authorized
Coordinates/cell/type indices are validated against model metadata

code: energy, force, virial = model.eval(coord, cell, atype)

recipes.restart: Inference is rerun for immutable model and input hashes.
failure_modes: Cell supplied for nonperiodic data or omitted for periodic data
scientific_checks: Compare a small public labeled fixture with dp test and verify output shapes before production use.

preconditions: LAMMPS build/plugin compatibility is proven
Model test and deployment envelope passed
LAMMPS atom types map exactly to O,H
MD execution is separately authorized

code: pair_style deepmd model.000.pth model.001.pth model.002.pth model.003.pth out_file md.out out_freq 10 atomic relative 1.0

recipes.restart: LAMMPS restart must preserve model hashes, type mapping, units, timestep, ensemble state, and random-state lineage.
scientific_checks: Compare single-point energy/forces against Python inference
Run short NVE drift and ensemble checks before longer MD
Stop on predeclared deviation threshold

preconditions: Isolated Python >=3.10 environment
Network/package installation authorized
recipes.restart: Recreate from the same lock.
scientific_checks: Installation does not prove that any format conversion preserves labels.

preconditions: OUTCAR completion and DFT acceptance are already established
Output directory is new
VASP energy/force/stress conventions are documented
recipes.restart: Delete or quarantine a partial output only under explicit authorization; otherwise write a new directory.
failure_modes: Frame order or atom order changes
Output mixed with an old conversion
scientific_checks: Count frames/atoms
Compare first and last frame species, cell, energy and force samples against source parsing
Hash row-to-source mapping

preconditions: Each LabeledSystem is independently audited
Global species/type policy and label coverage are explicit
Output directory is new

code: systems = [dpdata.LabeledSystem(path, fmt=fmt) for path, fmt in sources]
inputs: ordered sources list of path/format pairs

recipes.restart: Rebuild into a new directory after any input/order/type-map change.
failure_modes: Incompatible atom counts or type policy
scientific_checks: Preserve system/group provenance and split groups; mixed format is storage, not evidence of comparability.

preconditions: Isolated Python >=3.10 environment compatible with dpdata 1.0.2
Network/package installation authorized
recipes.restart: Recreate from a lock; record DPDispatcher and provider executable versions separately.
scientific_checks: Installation proves no remote machine, DFT engine, or model is ready.

preconditions: param.json and machine.json pass exact DP-GEN review
Training, exploration, and first-principles commands are version-pinned
Remote credentials are never stored in the catalog
Scheduler/remote/DFT writes and costs are authorized
Candidate/failed/accurate thresholds are predeclared
recipes.restart: Rerun the identical dpgen run command only after auditing existing iteration state, remote jobs, partial labels, and immutable param/machine hashes.

units.must_match: DeePMD, exploration engine, and first-principles label conventions declared in param.json

failure_modes: Candidate pool feedback leaks into independent test
scientific_checks: Audit every accepted FP label with its DFT Skill
Keep independent test/OOD outside the selection loop
Track ensemble seeds and per-iteration model/data lineage

preconditions: init-bulk parameters, structures, DFT settings, and output directory are reviewed
Machine file commands are pinned when supplied
recipes.restart: Resume only after identifying the last completed stage and checking remote job state; absence of machine.json means manual stage execution, not completion.
scientific_checks: Inspect generated volume/perturbation coverage and DFT convergence before training use.

preconditions: Simplification criteria and retained scientific coverage are explicit
param.json and machine.json are immutable

outputs: simplification work directories and selected data

recipes.restart: Audit partial state and rerun only with identical hashes.
scientific_checks: Compare composition, thermodynamic, structural, and error-tail coverage before and after simplification.

preconditions: task.json defines a supported property and exact model/reference settings
machine.json is reviewed before run
Each stage has separate authorization
recipes.restart: The documented run command can be repeated for restart, but remote/partial state must be audited first.

units.property_units: must be read from the selected autotest property definition and reference method

scientific_checks: Compare against an accepted reference calculation with property-specific convergence and uncertainty.
